description: The Agricultural Marketing Service has posted a Final Supplement 500 for Tuna Products, March 2026.  Primary updates include: adding the new verbiage for the "613 Va’ad" kosher canned tuna products for NYS Kosher Commodities Co-op. Minor updates include: under the delivered product section, a statement informing vendors that truck seal numbers must also be recorded on the BOL, per the Master Solicitation; added the new requirement to include the Solicitation Description Number on the Certificate of Loading issued by USDC/NOAA SIP; replaced immediate and shipping container verbiage with primary package and shipping case- throughout the document; and replaced supplier with contractor- throughout the document
